title: The local identity provider delivers what Cognito delivers
assertion: The development provider’s invitation and reset outboxes hold each message’s subject, text and HTML from `@tp/auth-mail`, and the e2e journeys read the temporary password and the reset code from the message’s own text, with no remote asset and no link but the sign-in address; the text is the HTML’s with its tags stripped, since Cognito sends the HTML alone, with no text part
noFileReason: The local identity provider writes its invitations and reset codes to a synthetic outbox the tests read; no file.
